set.body: Adopt effectagram as the canonical R package and project name. Rename package metadata and current design artifacts; update package-qualified calls, diagnostics, tests, benchmarks, and user-facing vision and mission; preserve mathematical API names such as effect_relation and effect_geometry; preserve historical ledger chronology while appending the naming decision; update active tracker identity without rewriting append-only history. Completion requires a clean old-name sweep with intentional historical exceptions plus source tests, installed-package tests, tarball build, and R CMD check.
set.title: Rename package and project identity to effectagram
